title: Sr. Clinical Study Manager
description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Position Scope:**
-------------------


The mission of the Clinical Affairs group within Medical and Scientific Affairs is to create customer value for ImmunoDiagnostic Division (IDD) by providing clinical evidence for product pre\-launch and post\-launch across the portfolio. Main responsibilities for the unit are:

* Own IDD Clinical Affairs planning, execution, and reporting.
* Develop timely and efficient clinical strategies to support product claims (mainly autoimmunity portfolio).
* Liaise with Regulatory Affairs organization to complete prioritized product registration plans in selected geographical areas (USA and EU.
* Liaise with the Medical Directors to align disease definition and study population characterizations
* Liaise with R\&D organization to align product specifications to be fulfilled and patient cohorts to be targeted.
* Liaise with Commercial Operations organizations to ensure desired products are available for sales on the territory.
* Liaise with Marketing organization to leverage on key customers and KOLs within clinical trials and support building sales supporting arguments on top of registration\-related claims.

**Essential Responsibilities:**
-------------------------------


Reporting to the Global Director Clinical Affairs, the Senior Clinical Project Manager will be responsible for:

* Lead cross\-functional, high\-complex and business critical clinical projects.
* Hold accountability and responsibility of all operational and safety deliverables of assigned company sponsored studies.
* Develop relevant clinical strategies and plans.
* Ensure clinical research programs are designed and conducted in accordance with company standards operating policies \& procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practices (GCP), ISO20916:2019, In\-Vitro Diagnostics Device Regulation (IVDR) and FDA regulation.
* Generate clinical evaluation plans and reports for FDA and IVDR submissions.
* Generate relevant Trial Master File documents and support CRAs for TMF quality checks and completeness.
* Be able to build a CRF (Case Report Form) starting from the clinical study plan and protocol/s
* Generate CPSP (Clinical performance study plan) according to the study needs and in collaboration with several projects’ functions
* Support CRAs during clinical study initiation and close out.
* Identify project risks and develop \& implement mitigation plans.
* Organize, plan, and lead cross\-functional, highly sophisticated and business\-critical projects, with a focus on development, registration, and commercialization of Immunodiagnostic products.
* Guaranty Audit and Inspection preparedness of all assigned projects.
* Be responsible for corrective action plans at individual sites and across trial.
* Report project progress to governance boards and raise issues to IDD management.
* Provide decision support and recommendations for critical decisions to IDD management.
* Help identify and drive assigned department goals.

**Knowledge, Skill, and Ability:**
----------------------------------

* Demonstrate Leadership to develop, empower and guide personnel to meet objectives.
* Excellent interpersonal written and verbal skills to communicate optimally across cross\-functional departments and cross\-sites.
* Proficient knowledge of medical terminology, clinical trial design and statistics.
* Proven detailed knowledge of guidelines, systems for clinical trial management and international regulations and practices (knowledge of CE IVDR required and IVD FDA/CFDA strong asset).
* Expertise with ISO20916:2019 required.
* Knowledge of immunology, auto\-immunity and/or allergy strongly preferred.
* Ability to develop and implement solutions to address identified problems.
* Excellent project management, organizational and time management skills.
* Willingness and ability to travel oversea for up to 30\-50% of time.
* Ability to work in a diverse team and dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Ability to provide clear directions and guidance to others.
* Desire to use experience to build innovative infrastructure and “standard processes”.
* Knowledge of a Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Document Management System (EDMS) and skill in using Microsoft Office suite.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree in biological sciences, nursing or related medical/scientific field or equivalent work experience.
* 5 years minimum preferred global clinical studies experience (in\-vitro medical devices experience preferred) with a minimum specifically in project management.
* Advanced written and spoken English and additional European language preferred.

title: Local Regulatory Responsible (LRR) (m/f/x) - Italy
description:
**Entity:** CSL Behring


**Job Category:** Research Development \& Sciences


**Job Family:** Global \& Regional Regulatory Affairs


**Job Type:** Full Time


**Location****:** Milan, Milano, Italy


**Employer Reference:** R\-287021


**Job Description**
-------------------


**Local Regulatory Responsible (LRR) (m/f/x) \- Italy**
=======================================================


Location: Milan, Italy


Contract Type: Permanent contract, Fulltime
  

Department: Regulatory Affairs  

  



**The Opportunity**


In this role, you will serve as the primary regulatory representative for Italy, ensuring compliance with local regulations, leading interactions with Health Authorities, and supporting product registrations and lifecycle management activities. You will work closely with regional regulatory teams, commercial operations, and external stakeholders to drive regulatory excellence and business success.


**The Role**


* Provide local regulatory expertise and input to support the development and execution of regulatory strategies for new product registrations and lifecycle management activities.
* Review promotional materials and provide regulatory guidance to ensure compliance with local regulations.
* Monitor and communicate progress of regulatory projects to relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with Italian regulatory requirements and evolving legislation.
* Support audit and inspection readiness activities and ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).
* Monitor changes in the regulatory landscape and communicate emerging requirements and industry trends to internal stakeholders.
* Participate in regulatory meetings, industry forums, and trade associations to represent company interests and share insights.
* Maintain compliance\-related KPIs and ensure regulatory information systems (RIMS) remain accurate and up to date.
* Serve as the primary contact for Italian Health Authorities and regulatory stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Health Authorities, industry groups, and trade associations.
* Lead local regulatory interactions related to licenses, submissions, and market access initiatives.
* Act as the regulatory representative for local Commercial Operations, providing strategic guidance and business\-focused regulatory support.
* Coordinate and prepare country\-specific regulatory documentation, including Module 1 and other local requirements.
* Support regional regulatory teams in submission planning and execution aligned with local requirements and business priorities.
* Track and communicate the status of regulatory submissions with local Health Authorities.
* Ensure regulatory compliance of product labeling, including SmPC, PIL, and packaging materials.
* Manage translation activities and required labeling updates.

**Your Skills and Experience:**


* Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline such as Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
* Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a scientific, healthcare, legal, or regulatory discipline preferred.
* Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) or other relevant professional certification is desirable.
* 3\-5\+ years of regulatory affairs experience in a Health Authority\-facing role within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry.
* Strong knowledge of Italian regulatory requirements and regulatory processes.
* In\-depth experience managing local Health Authority interactions.
* Experience managing regulatory submissions and product lifecycle activities.
* Demonstrated project management and cross\-functional leadership experience.
* Experience collaborating with commercial and business stakeholders in a matrix environment.
* Ability to adapt and perform effectively in a rapidly changing environment.
* Fluency in Italian and English, both written and spoken.
* Strong understanding of local health authority interactions and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global teams.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to escalate issues appropriately.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to thrive in a complex global matrix organization.

**What we offer**


We offer an open\-ended contract (Tempo Indeterminato) regulated by the CCNL Chimico Farmaceutico, with a gross annual salary range of €45,000 \- €55,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications. In addition, we provide an outstanding benefits package, an annual merit\-based reward process, and an individual development plan to support your professional growth and career progression.


**About CSL Behring**
---------------------



CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients' needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.


CSL Behring operates one of the world's largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.


To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/.



**Our Benefits**
----------------



For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well\-being \| CSL.



**You Belong at CSL**
---------------------



At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.


To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion\-and\-belonging



**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------



CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility\-statement.

title: Principal, Regulatory Science and Strategy - Real World Solutions
description:
Milan, Italy \| Full time \| Home\-based \| R1560548  
IQVIA is focused on using data and science to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. Individuals joining us are assured of a rewarding career in Life Sciences Consulting, with opportunities to address diverse and challenging client problems, contribute to cross\-geography engagements, interact with senior client leaders, and gain exposure to a multicultural and collaborative work environment.  


About our team – Regulatory Science and Strategy (RSS)  


The Regulatory Science and Strategy (RSS) group sits within IQVIA's Real World Solutions business and supports life sciences clients in using real world evidence (RWE) more widely and effectively for regulatory purposes. RSS sells and delivers as a unified team, partnering with clients on regulatory strategy, study design, and submission planning across drugs, biologics, and devices. Our work spans externally controlled trials, post\-marketing requirements (PMRs/PMCs), post\-authorization safety studies (PASS), drug utilization studies (DUS), and emerging regulatory technology.  


We are strategic thinkers, deep subject matter experts, and creative at our core. We are collaborative, intellectually curious, and entrepreneurial.  


About the role:  


As a Principal (Director\-level) within RSS, you will own delivery leadership, drive business development, and serve as a subject matter expert across two connected areas: selling and delivering standalone regulatory strategy engagements and cross\-functional RWE studies for regulatory decision\-making. Your work will focus primarily on several areas:  


First, a Principal is expected to lead high\-quality standalone regulatory strategy engagements, build trusted relationships with new and existing clients, and strengthen IQVIA's regulatory science and strategy capabilities.  


Second, the Principal acts as a subject matter expert on the use of RWE across the regulatory lifecycle, partnering cross\-functionally with IQVIA Real World Solutions teams to shape, sell, and deliver RWE studies from pre\-submission strategy through approval and post\-market commitments. An in\-depth understanding of EMA expectations is essential, with the ability to translate those expectations into study designs and submission strategies that clients can act on.  


Specifically, as a member of the RSS team, the Principal participates in regulatory strategy proposal development, advises on regulatory pathways, and supports cross\-functional proposal strategy and delivery for externally controlled trials, PASS, DUS, RegTech advisory work, and broader RWE\-for\-regulatory engagements.  


In addition we expect you to make a key Team and operational contributions to RSS, including mentorship and capability building amongst your junior colleagues  


Responsibilities  


Lead sell and delivery of standalone RSS regulatory strategy engagements, owning workstreams end\-to\-end and supporting team members on complex programs.  


Support cross\-functional IQVIA Real World Solutions teams in selling and delivering RWE generation programs for regulatory audiences, including externally controlled trials, premarket uses of RWE, PASS, and PMR/PMC fulfilment.  


Contribute to RSS regulatory intelligence activities, monitoring the external regulatory environment and surfacing emerging information relevant to IQVIA's offerings and clients.  


Act as a day\-to\-day owner of the regulatory science element of client engagements, with responsibility for client satisfaction and delivery quality.  


Advise on strategy and delivery plans for RSS services, with a focus on EMA RWE activities and lifecycle management, supported by working knowledge of FDA, MHRA, Health Canada, and PMDA.  


Maintain working familiarity with the activities and outputs of EMA and their impact on global harmonization of RW efforts.  


Identify follow\-on work and new revenue opportunities with existing clients, and support business development efforts with new client organizations.  


Collaborate across IQVIA when client requirements span regulatory affairs, clinical development, and real world insights.  


Provide direction, advice, and intellectual leadership to delivery teams and clients.  


Contribute high\-level input to client reports and presentations, and deliver findings to clients directly.  


Mentor and coach junior consultants, sharing subject matter expertise to build RSS capability.  


Participate in annual performance review processes and in recruitment of new staff.  


Skills and Experience  


The successful candidate will have a track record of success across most of the following competencies:  


Industry and regulatory expertise: Maintains a constant focus on regulators, industry, and client trends in life sciences. Applies this knowledge to active client engagements and to business development.  


Real world data expertise: Ability to advise on the design of real world studies to meet regulatory requirements, including externally controlled trials, PASS, PMR fulfillment, etc.  


Regulated medical product experience: Ability to speak with senior client stakeholders about EMA requirements, guidance, and expectations, with working knowledge of FDA, MHRA, Health Canada, and PMDA.  


Client relationship management and delivery: Day\-to\-day owner of client engagements, focused on client satisfaction and outstanding deliverables, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in parallel.  


Business development: Active contributor to proposal development and pre\-sales meetings for standalone regulatory strategy opportunities and cross\-functional RWE study opportunities with new and existing client organizations.  


Solution selling: Ability to identify client pain points and shape custom solutions for life sciences clients.  


Communication and executive presence: Expresses ideas clearly and concisely, and tailors messaging to the audience.  


Cooperative teamwork: Builds supportive relationships within RSS and across IQVIA, based on trust and respect.  


Management of others: Sets clear direction and develops junior team members by delegating appropriately and creating stretch opportunities.  


Coping with decision\-making, customer focus, flexibility, influencing, initiative, innovation, planning and organizing, strategic vision, and technological orientation.  


Qualifications and Other Requirements  


A strong academic track record in a life science\-related discipline or professional equivalent. A relevant graduate degree (PharmD, PhD, MD, MPH, or MS) is preferred.  


At least 7 years of professional experience, with a meaningful portion focused on regulatory science, regulatory strategy, or product review. Prior experience at EMA or another health authority is highly valued.  


Previous experience in life sciences consulting or professional services is preferred.  


Evidence of consistent career progression.  


A track record of project leadership and people development.  


Willingness and ability to travel to client locations.  


Fluency in English (spoken and written).  


Right to live and work in the recruiting country.  


IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com  


IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.  


Where you'll work  
Home\-based  


You’ll work remotely, with the flexibility to do your best work from home. Supported by collaborative tools and a global team, you’ll stay connected while enjoying the autonomy and balance that comes with a fully remote role.  
Culture  


Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

title: Medical Content Development Manager / Team Lead
description:
**Company Description**  

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!


Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

 **Job Description** **THE POSITION****:**

Medical Information is a critically important customer\-facing function that supports the safe and effective use of pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical device, and digital therapeutic products by providing timely, scientifically balanced, evidence based, non\-promotional information in response to unsolicited requests from healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, and payers.


An important aspect of medical information is developing, managing, and providing impactful medical response documents. This position is responsible for medical content development\-related client engagements.


This role requires medical information and medical content experience and knowledge, including excellent communication skills (both verbal and written),


The role is home office based, (full\-time position), and the eligible candidates must hold a valid work permit in the European Union, or the UK.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

* Plays an essential role supporting Global Medical Information / Medical Content Development Team on content development\-related engagements for clients who require medical content development and management services.
* Writes and creates medical and scientific content related to Medical Affairs, Medical Information and Medical Communications including, but not limited to, Scientific Response Documents (SRD), Frequently Asked Question (FAQ) documents, Slide Sets, Abstracts, Posters, Education and Training materials, and others for potential clients.
* Drives the client document development process from gathering materials and developing scientifically rigorous content to facilitating document review and discussions at medical, legal, regulatory (MLR) review meetings.
* Works with EVERSANA and/or client\-provided document management technology platforms (i.e., Veeva PromoMats / MedComms, etc.) as content owner when appropriate, uploading documents, providing reference anchoring and annotations as required.
* May be called up to perform scientific data fact checking for documents in support of medical reviewers participating in MLR teams.
* Collaborates with Global Medical Information / Medical Content Development Team and contributes to discussions on strategy, tactical execution and communication approaches for assigned projects.
* Provides direction and works closely with other medical writers and medical content development team to deliver on client projects efficiently and effectively.
* Participates in key client meetings as assigned.
* Supports creating/updating the SOPs, checklists, templates, style guides, and guidance documents as necessary.
* Stays knowledgeable of industry best practices and supports leadership team in evaluating and implementing new technologies and procedures to improve operational efficiency and quality of materials developed.
* Works collaboratively with other medical writers and creative teams across EVERSANA.
* Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
* All other duties as assigned*.*

 **EXPECTIONS OF THE JOB:**

* Responsible to deliver CLIENT DELIGHT
* Responsible to work collaboratively with EVERSANA medical information and medical affairs team and take direction and feedback from management and clients
* Responsible to ensure management and compliance with industry standards and codes of practice
* Able to work independently to develop high\-quality, scientifically accurate, strategically aligned, ethical, and compliant medical content
* Responsible to proactively flag and manage any quality issues, and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions
* **Travel** This position may require business travel and will need to be able to travel up to approximately 10\-15%.
* **Hours**: Able to work full time and be flexible with work scheduling as required by clients and management.

  

**Qualifications** **MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**


The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

* **Education:** Doctorate or Master of Science (MSc) degree in Life Sciences or healthcare or equivalent.
* **Experience and/or Training**:
* A minimum of 2\-year(s) experience in pharmaceutical industry or Medical Information / Medical Communications service provider. Experience developing global medical information materials, e.g., scientific response documents (SRDs), frequently asked questions (FAQs), custom response documents (CRDs), etc.
* Exceptional written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills including the ability to independently interpret and summarize complex results. Ability to establish credibility with a variety of audiences; especially with clients
* Ability to effectively interface with all levels of management and staff and to succeed in a matrix team setting while meeting or exceeding timelines.
* Proficient editing skills along with expertise in Microsoft Office, Acrobat and other applications.
* Experience conducting literature searches and working with tools such as PubMed, Ovid, Embase, etc.
* Experience working with reference management and citation software (e.g., EndNote, Mendeley, Citavi, etc.)
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and best practices in relationship to Medical Information, Medical Affairs and promotional and non\-promotional materials review
* Excellent project management skills and proven track record of being results driven
* Ability to conceptualize, design and deliver best in class solutions.

 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **Education**: A Pharm.D. or Pharm.M or a Degree in Medicine or PhD is preferred. Relevant Bachelor’s Degree in a Life Science also considered.
* **Experience:** Medical Information, Medical Communications, Medical Writing, Medical Affairs; experience developing medical content, especially Medical Information materials, for both new product launches and for updating and managing current materials; experience working across multiple therapeutic areas.
* **Communication Skills**: Possesses the ability to develop and articulate ideas and information that generate understanding and creates a climate that motivates and encourages others to participate.

title: Radwaste Worksite Senior Supervisor | Ispra, Varese
description:
***Building a sustainable future, together.***


At WSP, we design the future of our communities. As one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms, we bring together expertise across transport and infrastructure, buildings, energy, environment, water and advisory. In Italy, we combine local knowledge with international reach to deliver projects that create a positive, lasting impact for clients, communities and the environment.  

  

We are growing our Nuclear Decommissioning and Waste Management capability and are looking for a Radwaste Worksite Senior Supervisor to support activities connected to a nuclear decommissioning programme in Ispra. The programme involves the safe decommissioning of nuclear installations and the management of associated radioactive waste.

**The opportunity**


This is a unique opportunity to contribute to one of the most relevant nuclear decommissioning programmes in Italy, supporting onsite activities related to radioactive waste management at the client site in Ispra.


This role requires strong autonomy in defining operational strategies, guiding practical solutions and supporting onsite teams in a highly regulated technical environment.

**How you will make an impact**


Your work will support the correct management of radioactive waste generated by decommissioning activities, with a focus on technical strategy, senior\-level worksite supervision, documentation and daily coordination with project stakeholders.

* Lead the identification of strategies and the implementation of practical solutions for radioactive waste management onsite.
* Provide senior\-level worksite supervision, ensuring activities are aligned with project requirements, safety expectations and technical standards.
* Apply and interpret nuclear safety, radiation protection, radioactive waste classification and relevant regulatory requirements, including the Italian framework.
* Review technical documentation, QA/QC records, status updates and supporting project materials.
* Provide clear daily reporting to the Project Manager on onsite progress, technical issues, risks, decisions and next steps.
* Collaborate with client technical teams, WSP colleagues, contractors and other project stakeholders in a senior client\-facing technical role.

**The team around you**


You will be employed by WSP and work full\-time on\-site at the client site in Ispra, as part of a wider programme dedicated to nuclear decommissioning and waste management. You will collaborate closely with client technical stakeholders while remaining fully part of WSP, with ongoing internal support, coordination and access to wider technical expertise.


The working environment is technical, hands\-on and client\-facing, with activities taking place both in office settings and in the field. This is not only a client assignment: it is part of WSP’s growth in nuclear services, offering exposure to a specialized sector, international knowledge\-sharing and the opportunity to contribute to safe, compliant and practical decommissioning work.


As some activities may be performed in classified areas, personnel assigned to this role will be designated as professionally exposed. This will be further discussed during the interview process.

**What you will bring to the role**


We are looking for a senior professional with a strong nuclear background, proven technical judgement and the ability to guide practical decisions in a regulated onsite environment.

* Master’s degree, preferably in Nuclear Engineering, or in Energy, Mechanical, Civil, Environmental Engineering or Physics with documented nuclear training.
* At least 10 years of relevant experience in radioactive waste management, nuclear activities or nuclear decommissioning.
* Strong knowledge of nuclear safety, radiation protection, radioactive waste classification and radioactive waste management.
* Experience defining technical strategies and implementing practical solutions in complex nuclear or decommissioning environments.
* Availability to work full\-time onsite in Ispra, with the ability to operate effectively in a client\-facing technical environment.
* Fluency in English and Italian is required.
* Experience with MS Project or Primavera, Microsoft Office, STRIMS, technical documentation and QA/QC processes would be valuable.


We are looking for someone who can bring senior technical judgement, guide others through complex onsite situations and help strengthen WSP’s growing capability in nuclear decommissioning and radioactive waste management.

**Life at WSP**


When our people thrive, our projects thrive. At WSP, you will be supported to build your career, take on meaningful challenges and learn from talented professionals across a global network. This role offers the chance to contribute to a highly specialized programme in Italy while remaining connected to WSP’s broader technical community.

**Compensation and benefits**


WSP is committed to pay transparency. The annual gross salary for this position starts from **€43,000**, with the final offer determined based on the successful candidate’s experience, qualifications, technical expertise and alignment with the role requirements. In addition to base salary, we offer a benefits package and opportunities for professional development.

**Our partnership approach**


We see recruitment as a two\-way conversation. Our process is designed to be transparent, collaborative and respectful of your time. For this role, the process is expected to include:

* **Introductory conversation**: A first conversation with Talent Acquisition to discuss your experience, availability, salary expectations and work authorization.
* **Technical interview**: A discussion with the hiring manager to explore your nuclear background, worksite experience and senior\-level technical fit for the programme.
* **Client interview:** A further conversation with client stakeholders before final confirmation.

**Come as you are**


We are building teams that reflect the diverse communities we serve. For this specific role, some requirements are essential due to the technical, regulated and onsite nature of the work. If your background is relevant but you are not sure whether you meet every point, we still encourage you to apply.


All applications will be treated with confidentiality and considered under equal opportunities principles.

**Ready to help shape what’s next?**


If you are looking for a senior role where you can contribute to a highly specialised nuclear decommissioning programme and make a practical onsite impact, we would love to hear from you.


Apply now and discover what you can achieve with WSP.

**Accessibility and adjustments**


We want our recruitment process to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the process, please let us know so we can support you.

**Job Title**


Business Analyst**About your role:**


Reporting to the Programme Director and/or Programme Manager, the role of Business Analyst is to support client implementations, conversions and migration initiatives by gathering, analysing and documenting business and functional requirements in line with programme objectives and delivery needs.


Working closely with clients, internal Fiserv teams and third\-party partners, the Business Analyst plays a key role in ensuring that business needs are clearly understood, translated into structured functional requirements and aligned to solution capabilities, operational processes and target\-state outcomes.


The Business Analyst is responsible for supporting analysis activities across the full project lifecycle, from initial requirements definition and current\-state assessment through functional documentation, testing support, go\-live readiness and transition to BAU. The role acts as a critical link between business stakeholders, subject matter experts, implementation teams, product, technology and testing teams to help ensure that solutions are delivered in line with business, operational and technical requirements.


Within this context, the role requires a solid understanding of issuing and card\-processing environments, including client servicing, operational processes and the impacts of migrating from legacy platforms to modern target solutions.

**What you’ll do:**

* Leading business and functional requirements discussions with clients, internal stakeholders and subject matter experts to gather, validate and document project needs.
* Analysing current\-state and target\-state processes to identify functional gaps, operational impacts, dependencies and areas requiring clarification or design decisions.
* Defining and documenting business requirements, functional requirements, process flows, business rules, user stories and other supporting analysis artefacts.
* Translating business needs into clear, structured and actionable functional requirements for implementation, product, technology and testing teams.
* Supporting solution definition activities by working closely with SMEs, implementation teams, product teams and technical teams to assess options and recommend appropriate functional approaches.
* Producing and maintaining analysis documentation across the project lifecycle, including requirements packs, functional specifications, gap analysis, decision logs and process documentation.
* Developing and maintaining requirements traceability to ensure approved requirements, changes and decisions are tracked and aligned to delivery outcomes.
* Supporting the documentation of the overall functional approach, including impacts to client processes, operational models, controls and target\-state solution design.
* Identifying, analysing, researching and resolving functional queries raised by internal teams, clients and third\-party partners.
* Supporting impact assessments related to process changes, regulatory and compliance requirements, operational readiness and implementation activities.
* Working closely with issuing, card\-processing and operational stakeholders to ensure that business priorities, processing requirements and client expectations are clearly understood and reflected in the solution.
* Supporting readiness activities by ensuring that requirements, process impacts, decisions and functional dependencies are clearly understood by all relevant stakeholders.
* Acting as a key liaison between business stakeholders and delivery teams throughout the implementation lifecycle, ensuring clear communication and alignment at all stages.


Execution \& Controls

* Managing and maintaining business analysis deliverables in accordance with established Fiserv governance, standards and project methodology.
* Supporting the planning, prioritisation and delivery of business analysis activities in line with project milestones, implementation phases and delivery timelines.
* Ensuring that requirements are reviewed, validated, approved and baselined in line with agreed governance processes.
* Tracking requirement changes, open points, assumptions, dependencies and key decisions throughout the lifecycle of the project.
* Supporting the creation and maintenance of functional documentation required for implementation, testing, readiness and go\-live activities.
* Working with implementation, product, technology and testing teams to ensure requirements are fully understood and correctly translated into solution design and delivery outputs.
* Supporting testing activities by reviewing test scenarios, validating coverage against requirements and assisting with defect analysis, functional clarifications and issue resolution.
* Supporting user acceptance testing, operational readiness assessments and go\-live preparation from a functional and business process perspective.
* Participating in governance meetings, status reviews, workshops and working sessions to provide updates on analysis progress, requirement status, key decisions and unresolved issues.
* Escalating risks, issues, requirement gaps or delivery concerns to the appropriate stakeholders in a timely and structured manner.
* Maintaining clear and consistent communication with clients, internal teams and third parties on requirements, impacts, decisions and functional changes.
* Supporting implementation events and critical project milestones by providing functional expertise and analysis support where required.


Closeout \& Transition

* Confirming that business and functional requirements have been delivered, validated and transitioned appropriately into implementation, testing, warranty and BAU support processes.
* Supporting the completion of final documentation and ensuring that approved requirements, decisions and analysis artefacts are archived appropriately.
* Assisting with the review of implementation outcomes, requirement coverage, defects and lessons learned to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Ensuring that outstanding functional queries, requirement gaps or follow\-up actions are tracked through to closure or transitioned appropriately into warranty and BAU support processes.
* Contributing to post\-implementation reviews and Lessons Learned activities where applicable.

**Experience you’ll need to have:**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with professional proficiency in both English and Italian.
* Working knowledge of issuing, card\-processing and payments operations, with an understanding of how business requirements translate into processing and operational outcomes.
* Subject Matter Expert / Business Analyst experience in one or more of the following areas strongly preferred: Regulatory, Compliance, Payment Schemes, Card Processing, Customer Correspondence, Fulfillment, Collections, Risk/Fraud, Disputes, Chargebacks, Retrievals, Testing, Consumer Finance, Credit Cards, Loans, Debit Cards and Retail Cards.
* Significant proven experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, functional analysis or solution analysis roles, within the Financial Services industry, in the Cards and Payments sector; experience in card and/or payment processing environments is preferred (6\-10 years).
* Proven experience supporting and/or leading business analysis activities for medium to large client\-facing implementations, conversions or migration initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and workstreams.

**Experience that would be great to have:**

* Business Analysis certification or equivalent professional training preferred.
* Experience in issuing, card\-processing or broader consumer finance environments strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting migrations from legacy platforms to modern processing platforms.
* Experience working on multi\-country programmes and complex client delivery initiatives.
* Exposure to regulatory, operational or processing change initiatives within issuing environments preferred.

title: Head of Finance and Operations at IT/Energy Nonprofit (Remote | English & German)
description:
**Head of Finance and Operations at IT \& Energy Nonprofit (Remote \| English \& German)**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


**Location**: Fully remote. We welcome applications from a range of countries, provided there is sufficient working\-hours overlap with our European team. Our ability to hire in a particular country depends on local employment arrangements and compensation levels.  

**Employment**: Full\-time preferred; 80\-100% arrangements can be considered.  

**Languages**: Fluent English required; German strongly preferred  

**Experience Required**: Significant relevant experience in Finance \& Operations, typically 8\+ years.  

**Salary Range**: Market\-related by region and based on experience  

**Work Travel Requirements**: Up to once per quarter  

**Start Date Goal**: Flexible, depending on notice period


### **About Us:**



Open Energy Transition (OET) is a German nonprofit making energy planning faster, more equitable and more trusted. We do this by developing and applying open\-source software and data.



Our fully remote team of around 50 people works with grid operators, regulators, funders and other energy institutions around the world. Our operating model combines philanthropic funding, complex B2B and B2G projects, and software products and services.



As OET grows, we are bringing our Finance and Operational functions under one senior leader.



To learn more about OET and our team, visit our website and browse around our public Handbook.


### **The role**



We are looking for a **Head of Finance \& Operations** to lead the organizational backbone that enables OET to scale effectively and sustainably.



In this role, you will be part of OET's senior leadership team, and the CEO's primary partner for matters relating to business operations, risk mitigation, and financial management.



Reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead financial management, project and grant finance, business administration and internal business systems. You will also oversee the existing people operations and coordinate internal teams and external consultants to ensure we meet deadlines and regulations in the IT support, information security, data protection, and corporate compliance areas, ensuring that they all have clear ownership and appropriate specialist support.



A major priority will be building strong financial management across a project\-heavy organization. This includes **restricted funds, project budgets, cost allocation, forecasting, financial reporting and donor or client requirements.**



This is a role with **broad accountability, not an expectation that one person does everything**. While we expect a hands\-on leader, you will lead a lean internal team and coordinate project leads, technical colleagues, and external specialists across areas such as accounting, tax, legal, IT, information security, and data protection.



You will have significant freedom to shape the team, systems, and external\-support model as OET grows. Important is that you enjoy building better organizations: creating clarity, improving systems, solving problems, and helping colleagues make good decisions.


### **️ What you will own**



Finance \& Project Control



* Lead organizational budgeting, forecasting, cash management, controlling, and management reporting.


* Own the financial framework for projects and restricted funds, including budgeting, cost allocation, expenditure tracking, and forecasting.


* Ensure reliable accounting, payroll, banking, tax, statutory reporting, and audits together with internal colleagues and external advisors.


* Partner with the CEO and Project Leads on proposal budgets, contracts, pricing, indirect\-cost recovery, and major financial decisions.


* Provide clear financial analysis that helps leadership and project teams make sound decisions.


* Ensure information security, data protection, organizational risk, and business continuity activities meet internal and regulatory standards, by coordinating with a team of specialist colleagues and external advisors.



Business Operations \& Systems



* Own core business administration, including contracts, procurement, vendors, insurance, BusOps policies and recurring corporate obligations.


* Develop and improve OET's finance and business systems, including ERP, project accounting, reporting, workflows and automation.


* Establish a scalable internal IT support function covering employee support, access and account management, onboarding and offboarding, business software and vendor coordination.


* Ensure information security, data protection, organizational risk and business\-continuity activities are appropriately managed together with specialist colleagues and external advisors.


* Identify operational bottlenecks and build pragmatic solutions that work for a growing, fully remote organization.



Team \& Organization


* Lead and develop a lean team across Finance, People Operations and Administration/Operations roles.
* Set clear responsibilities and ensure important operational work is coordinated and completed.
* Decide what should be handled internally, automated, or supported by specialist external providers.
* Work closely with the CEO and other leaders to continuously strengthen OET's operating model.

### **✅ What you bring**



We are looking for someone with:


* Significant experience in finance, accounting, controlling, or finance\-led business operations.
* Strong experience with project accounting, restricted funds, grants, or contract\-funded work.
* Broad business\-administration experience beyond finance, for example across systems, vendors, contracts, organizational processes or people operations.
* Experience building or substantially improving finance and operational systems in a growing organization.
* Confidence working with accountants, auditors, banks, software providers, and other professional advisors.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn financial and operational information into clear decisions.
* Experience leading people and creating effective teams.
* Excellent written and spoken English, a high level of integrity, and comfort working in an autonomous, fully remote, asynchronous organization.


You **do not need to be an expert in every operational discipline**. We value the ability to establish ownership, work effectively with specialists, and ensure outcomes are delivered.


### **Bonus Points For:**


* Knowledge of German accounting, tax, or non\-profit administration.
* Professional proficiency in German. Our internal lingua franca is English, but German is a big bonus for some external stakeholders.
* Experience in a project\-based nonprofit, professional\-services organization, technology / IT company, or SaaS environment.
* Experience with donor reporting, public grants, or multi\-country projects.
* Experience with ERP and project accounting systems such as Odoo or DATEV.
* Experience establishing internal IT support or IT service management processes.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC2, data protection, or comparable governance frameworks.
* A finance, accounting, or business administration qualification, or equivalent professional training.


A university degree is **not required**. We care more about demonstrated financial competence, business judgement, and the ability to build effective organizations.


### **✨ Why OET**



This role offers:



* **Real influence:** you will report directly to the CEO and play an important role in organizational and financial decisions.


* **Meaningful ownership:** lead a critical function while having the freedom to shape how it operates.


* **Interesting complexity:** work across international projects, philanthropy, software, and organizational growth.


* **High autonomy:** join a fully remote, flexible, high\-trust working environment.


* **Meaningful mission:** help strengthen an organization working on critical infrastructure and the global energy transition.


### **Application process**



Please apply with your resume and brief answers to a small number of role\-specific questions. A generic cover letter is not required.



The selection process will include an introductory conversation, structured interviews focused on relevant experience and working style, a short practical case based on situations you could encounter in the role, and reference checks. OET may also require applicable background checks, depending on the final nature of the role, subject to agreement by the successful candidate.



OET is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, and encourage you to apply if you meet most of the essential requirements, even if you do not meet every preferred qualification.

Acquire expert‑level knowledge and apply the REX account.

Manage sanctions and restricted\-party screening for all cross\-border transactions.

A true change agent who acts with integrity, collaborates across boundaries, adapts quickly, takes initiative and keeps users at the center — fostering an open, innovative, and high\-performing environment.**What you will do**


As Digital Analytics \& Web Performance Specialist, you will be the go\-to person for digital performance analysis at HQ level and for operational support to local markets. You will have full ownership of the CRO and A/B testing platforms adopted by the company, independently managing vendor relationships, account configuration and day\-to\-day analytical support to internal stakeholders. Your work will have a direct impact on the optimization of the user experience across the Group's websites and on the effectiveness of each market's digital strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Data Analysis \& Stakeholder Support*

* Collect, interpret and respond to analysis requests from local markets, acting as the dedicated point of contact for all Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)\-related needs.
* Produce advanced reports and custom dashboards to monitor digital KPIs, traffic trends, user behavior and website performance, tailoring outputs to each market's needs.
* Manage CRM analytics, campaigns results and revenues contributions, integrating data across the funnel.
* Proactively identify insights, anomalies and optimization opportunities through continuous data analysis, supporting HQ and local stakeholders in strategic decisions.
* Work closely with the Digital Technologist to ensure correct media campaign tracking configuration (UTMs, events, conversions), guaranteeing data accuracy and ROAS calculation.
* Support local markets in assessing the impact of media investments, recommending optimizations grounded in analytical evidence.

*CRO \& A/B Testing Platform Ownership*

* Independently manage the CRO and A/B testing platforms adopted by the company, becoming the internal reference for their use and evolution.
* Act as the testing evangelist across local markets, fostering a culture of experimentation for web experience and CRM campaign development, while supporting teams in the design, execution, and analysis of testing activities.
* Develop deep expertise on the platforms in use, staying up to date with new features and industry best practices.
* Support vendor relationships for CRO platforms: handle commercial and support interactions, renewal negotiations and technical liaison.
* Manage platform user administration: access provisioning, role assignment and onboarding of new internal users and local market teams.
* Coordinate and operationally support local markets in the setup, launch and analysis of A/B testing and personalization experiments, ensuring sound methodologies and interpretable results.
* Monitor active experiments on a daily basis, flag anomalies and produce result summaries to support UX optimization decisions.
* Collaborate with UX, DTC Managers, Local Digital Marketing teams to define the experimentation roadmap, prioritizing tests based on potential impact and technical feasibility.

*Web Performance \& UX Optimization*

* Analyze navigation funnels and engagement metrics to identify friction points and propose user experience optimization solutions.
* Assess the impact of organic and paid traffic on website performance, contributing to UX reviews with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Support SEO and Media teams with impact analysis of their activities, providing data and analytical readings to inform their strategies.
* Contribute to defining shared measurement and tracking standards across HQ and local markets, ensuring data consistency and quality.

**What you need to succeed**

***Technical Skills***

* Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4\): advanced navigation, segment creation, exploration funnels, custom events and attribution.
* Hands\-on experience with CRO activites and A/B testing platforms (e.g. AB Tasty, VWO, Optimizely, or equivalent).
* Ability to build reports and dashboards in BI tools (e.g. Looker Studio, Power BI or equivalent).
* Understanding of how the main digital channels work (SEO, Paid Search, Paid Social, Email) and their impact on analytics data.
* Knowledge of digital CRM logic and customer journey data.
* Familiarity with web performance metrics (Core Web Vitals, page load speed, etc.) and technical analysis tools (e.g. Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights).
* Good command of English (C1 level or above), required for communication with international stakeholders and vendor management.
* Knowledge of heatmap and session recording tools (e.g. Hotjar, Contentsquare, Microsoft Clarity).
* Familiarity with the fundamentals of UX Research and User Testing.

***Soft Skills***

* Strong data and measurement orientation: you don't stop at the number — you look for the why.
* Ability to listen to and manage requests from multiple stakeholders with competing priorities.
* Proactive attitude and operational independence: you are able to manage tools and processes on your own without waiting to be told how.
* Excellent communication skills: you can translate complex data into clear messages for non\-technical audiences.
* Structured approach and attention to detail, even in multi\-market contexts with high variability.
* Collaborative mindset and cross\-functional teamwork orientation.

title: Senior Commercial & Contracts Manager, Continental Europe
description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 52,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

Supporting operations across Continental Europe, the **Senior Commercial \& Contracts Manager** will play a key role in driving commercial excellence across the region. This position is not focused on sales or business development; instead, it provides leadership in pricing strategy, contract negotiation, commercial governance, risk management and bid support across multiple sectors and geographies.


Working closely with operational, finance, legal and business leaders, the successful candidate will oversee the commercial and contractual aspects of opportunities and projects, ensuring effective pricing, robust governance, sound risk management and successful project delivery across the region.


This role offers hybrid working and **can be based in our Madrid or Milan offices**, with occasional travel to other locations across Continental Europe as required.

*Here’s what you’ll do:*

**Leadership \& Planning**

* Develop and implement pricing strategies in our bids aligned with Country, Business Lines and Sector goals and growth plans.
* Advise Continental Europe leadership on potential market risks, opportunities, pricing and commercial trends/ benchmarking to support our bids.
* Work collaboratively with the rest of the Continental Europe business applying a consistent approach across the Countries and the Sectors.

**Contract \& Risk Management**

* Oversee negotiation and implementation of prime and subcontracts, NDAs, MOUs, teaming agreements, and JV arrangements working collaboratively with the internal and external legal teams.
* Ensure changes (additional scopes, variation orders, etc.) are managed rigorously with a focus on commercial implications of change, manage commercial risk and opportunity generally.
* Ensure robust risk management procedures are embedded across bid and delivery phases.
* Resolve contractual disputes and claims, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
* Lead and implement internal governance process and interface with various corporate functions such as legal, tax, treasury, risk management, etc.

**Commercial Oversight**

* Oversee and support financial project budgeting in conjunction with developing an effective project delivery model with project leads aligned to commercial goals
* With support for the finance function provide effective project performance reporting across the portfolio.
* Work with project leads to identify and assess change.
* Monitor KPIs and cash flow to ensure commercial targets are met.

**Leadership \& Development**

* Support in the growth of the commercial team/ function, fostering a high\-performance culture.
* Coach and mentor staff on commercial best practices and contract management.
* Promote diversity, succession planning, and continuous professional development.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients, sub\-consultants, and key internal stakeholders to meet project objectives.
* Represent the business in commercial negotiations (new projects and change control) and industry forums.
* Attend client meetings/ interviews as required
* Influence bid/ delivery strategy and support work\-winning activities.


If you're passionate about innovation and turning bold ideas into reality, AECOM welcomes you. Join our team, where we don't just construct infrastructure but also uplift communities and enhance lives.

 **Qualifications** **Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?**

*Here’s what we’re looking for:*

* Degree or equivalent in Business, Engineering, Law or related discipline.
* Significant experience in contract, commercial, pricing and bid/tender management within engineering, infrastructure, defense, social infrastructure, energy, data centre or related professional services environments, including support for bid development, contract negotiations and commercial governance.
* Experience supporting bid development, pricing strategies, contract negotiations and commercial governance within a multi\-country environment.
* Languages skills: Fluent English and Spanish or Italian is essential; additional European languages, particularly French, German or Swedish, would be advantageous.
* Proven track record in leadership or key role with commercial and operational responsibilities.
* Strong commercial acumen with a solid understanding of construction and engineering services procurement routes, contracting models, professional services frameworks, pricing methodologies, commercial benchmarking, and project delivery models across infrastructure, defence, social infrastructure, energy, and commercial sectors.
* Experienced in negotiation and dispute resolution.
* Effective communicator with outstanding interpersonal abilities.
* Skilled in producing fee proposals, financial analysis, commercial reporting, and risk mitigation.


We celebrate diversity, including neurodiversity, and believe it enriches our team. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and abilities. If you are an applicant with a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us at ReasonableAdjustments@aecom.com. At AECOM, we value everyone's unique contributions and perspectives.


If you meet some of the requirements above or have transferable skills you believe would benefit us, we would be delighted to hear from you!

 **Additional Information**  

Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

*At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.* ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**


You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community \- where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
